modalities.evidence: using wearable sensors to log physiological data

output.population: 23 students and 6 teachers at a K-12 private school in the suburbs of Melbourne, Australia, plus 17 monitored classrooms.
output.summary: Field study in a Melbourne K-12 school pairing indoor and outdoor environmental sensor logs with wearable physiological recordings and daily surveys of thermal comfort, learning engagement, emotions and seating behaviours.
